PR Summary by Qodo

Add Save all for received media (experimental; do not merge) ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 20-40 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Add Save all to hand received files to one share sheet or download them on laptops.
>• Skip files already saved, and let users retry after a cancelled or failed share.
>• Add unit and two-browser coverage; document the feature and its test status.
>• Experimental test copy: do not merge.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD B["Save all tap"] --> S["Select received files"] --> D{"Batch shareable?"} D -->|Yes| H["Share sheet"] --> M["Mark handed over"] --> T["Show status"] D -->|No or retry| L["Paced downloads"] --> M ```
High-Level Assessment

>The following are alternative approaches to this PR:
1. Client-side ZIP for desktop fallback
- ➕ One desktop download avoids multiple-download prompts and pacing. - ➖ Adds archive creation and memory cost for large media. - ➖ Users must unpack files instead of receiving individual downloads.
>**Recommendation:** The current approach preserves individual files and supports native batch sharing without an archive dependency. Evaluate browser restrictions on multiple downloads during this experiment; do not merge this test copy.

Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (4) 📘 Rule violations (1)
1. A photo can be saved twice during a batch 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>save(p) starts an individual share or download without consulting Save all’s in-progress state,
>while tap() uses a snapshot and does not recheck handed before each download. If someone taps a
>photo during a download batch, that photo can download immediately and again when the batch reaches
>it; an individual share pending before Save all can likewise put the same file in both share
>attempts.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/index.html[R327-328]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/135/files#diff-8f62b6ced28d3396b501d2e89a2e7cb761d16cd7dc977aebece03d4a5da5c24eR327-R328) > >```diff >+ if (navigator.canShare?.({ files: [file] })) navigator.share({ files: [file] }).then(() => saveAll.handed.add(p.pid), () => {}); >+ else { downloadFile(file); saveAll.handed.add(p.pid); } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Individual saves and Save all can hand over the same photo concurrently or during a download batch. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/index.html[323-343] >- web/saveall.js[24-56] >## Recommended Fix >Use shared in-progress and per-photo pending state across both entry points. Prevent an individual save during a batch, exclude an individual save already in progress from a new batch, and recheck eligibility before each delayed download. Clear pending state on cancellation or failure while preserving the synchronous share call inside the tap. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/e2188c55-a5a6-4c5c-9dd9-54c5b3abd3bf?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/e2188c55-a5a6-4c5c-9dd9-54c5b3abd3bf)
2. Photos marked handed over before their download is confirmed 📘 Rule violation
>
>Description >
> >
>In createSaveAll, tap() adds a photo to handed immediately after download(ready[i].file)
>returns, and save(p) does the same after downloadFile(file), even though the anchor click only
>starts a download. If the browser blocks automatic downloads or the user declines the
>multiple-download prompt, later Save all taps skip the photo and the toast still counts it as `Saved
>N`.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R53-54]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/135/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR53-R54) > >```diff >+ if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); >+ try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Save all treats a returned programmatic anchor click as a confirmed download. If the browser blocks the download or the user declines it, the photo can be excluded from future attempts while the toast says it was saved. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[50-55] >- web/index.html[325-334] > >## Recommended Fix >Define whether the flow promises a started download or confirmed delivery. If confirmation is available, have `download` report it and add a photo to `handed` only after confirmation. Where the browser cannot confirm delivery, label the count as started rather than saved, make uncertain or detectable blocked handoffs visible, and keep blocked photos retryable. Consider a retryable bulk-download flow that addresses automatic-download permission, or one download containing the untouched original file bytes. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/69847609-a367-4645-8c8d-1a8bf665b650?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/69847609-a367-4645-8c8d-1a8bf665b650)

3. A stalled share blocks later Save all taps 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>tap() sets busy and awaits share(list), with its only reset in the finally block after that
>promise settles. If the browser share promise remains pending, every later Save all tap returns
>“Still saving” for the rest of the tab session.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[42]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/135/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR42-R42) > >```diff >+ try { await share(list); } catch (e) { >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A share promise that never settles keeps Save all busy indefinitely. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[32-56] >## Recommended Fix >Add a user-visible recovery path for a stalled share without awaiting before the initial share call. Account for a late settlement so that recovery cannot silently hand over the same files twice. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/dd3e7692-f360-44e1-8a01-412b46e1c687?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/dd3e7692-f360-44e1-8a01-412b46e1c687)

4. Failed downloads still show as saved 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>tap() displays Saved ${ready.length} before trying any download and catches each thrown download
>error with only a console warning. If URL creation or a download-start call throws, the affected
>photo remains eligible for retry, but the person receives a success message rather than notice that
>it failed.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R51-54]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/135/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR51-R54) > >```diff >+ toast(`Saved ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); >+ for (let i = 0; i < ready.length; i++) { >+ if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); >+ try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The success toast precedes download attempts, and thrown failures are reported only to the console. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[50-56] >## Recommended Fix >Count successful download-start calls and caught failures, then show an accurate result or partial-failure toast after the loop. Keep failed photos eligible for the next tap and avoid calling an unconfirmed browser download complete. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/0a77e89e-892d-4788-a8d6-978bea29dca9?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/0a77e89e-892d-4788-a8d6-978bea29dca9)
5. Verifying photos appear missing 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>saveBatch() counts still-arriving photos solely from incoming, but the transfer handler removes
>an entry before done() finishes asynchronous hash verification and puts its file in files. A
>Save all tap during that interval reports “Nothing new to save” when the completed photo is neither
>counted as arriving nor ready.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[17]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/135/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR17-R17) > >```diff >+ for (const fid of incoming.keys()) if (!fid.startsWith('thumb:') && !files.has(fid)) arriving++; >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A completed transfer disappears from both Save all lists while its hash is being verified. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/index.html[205-210] >- web/index.html[222-238] >- web/saveall.js[10-18] >## Recommended Fix >Track full-photo verification as an in-progress state until the file is stored or verification fails, and include that state in the Save all arriving count. Preserve the existing rule that only verified files can be handed over. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
